title: Tiger Woods' former mistress Rachel Uchitel spends $100,000 on cosmetic surgery makeover
summary_full: Rachel Uchitel, who made headlines in 2009 after being linked to golfer Tiger Woods, has reportedly spent $100,000 on cosmetic surgery. The 51-year-old podcast host underwent a facelift, brow lift and other procedures after years of facial fillers and aesthetic treatments left her unhappy with her appearance. She says she wanted a fresher, more natural look.
